steps.title: Fire and light
steps.body: Vines that burn away, torches to light, bombs that break cracked walls, and beams of light that mirrors turn onto a sensor: they are under Starter pack › Fire and light, and each works by itself.
steps.task: Open Starter pack in the bottom dock.

steps.title: Vines, a branch and two torches
steps.body: Place Vines across the way 6 studs in front of the start, a Branch on the ground 3 studs ahead and a little to the left, a Burning torch (already alight) 2 studs ahead to the right, and a Torch stand (not lit) further to the right.
steps.task: Place Vines, a Branch, a Burning torch and a Torch stand.

steps.title: Light the branch, burn the vines
steps.body: Press Play and walk over the Branch: it goes into item button 1 (J). Walk up to the Burning torch and press J: the branch catches fire (it burns for 30 seconds, then it is used up). Walk to the vines and press J: they burn away. The vines are tall: you can also climb them (walk into them; W up, S down, Space lets go).
steps.task: Press Play, light the branch at the Burning torch and burn the vines.

steps.title: Light the torch stand
steps.body: Walk to the unlit torch stand and press J with the branch still burning: the stand lights and stays lit. If the branch has burned up, take another, or light a new one at the Burning torch. A torch stand only answers fire. A Timed torch goes out again after its seconds; Light all the torches (Scripts and cutscenes) opens a gate when they all burn.
steps.task: Light the torch stand with the burning branch.

steps.title: A cracked wall and a bomb flower
steps.body: Stop the game. Place a Cracked wall to the left of the start, and a Bomb flower in front of it, a few studs away. Only an explosion breaks a cracked wall. The flower grows a bomb; if a bomb misses, it grows another.
steps.task: Place a Cracked wall and a Bomb flower.

steps.title: Blow it up
steps.body: Press Play. Walk up to the Bomb flower and press E (Pick up): the hero lifts a lit bomb and holds it up in front. Walk toward the wall and press E: the bomb is thrown (Action throws while you walk). Or stand still by the wall and press E to put it down, then step back. It goes off after 4 seconds and the wall breaks. Missed? The flower grows a new bomb: try again.
steps.task: Press Play, pick a bomb from the flower and break the wall.

steps.title: A beam, a mirror and a sensor
steps.body: Stop the game. About 9 studs ahead of the start, off to the right: place a Mirror 12 studs right of the way the start looks, and a Sun crest 8 studs to its left, turned (T) so it shines right into the mirror. Put a Light sensor 6 studs beyond the mirror (further from the start). The beam is a bright yellow line at waist height, running straight from the crest until something stops it.
steps.task: Place a Sun crest, a Mirror and a Light sensor ahead and to the right.

steps.title: Turn the mirror
steps.body: Press Play. To see the whole puzzle, drag up in the play view to look down from above, and scroll to zoom out. The beam crosses from the crest into the mirror, and the mirror sends it back toward you, away from the sensor. Walk up to the mirror (from any side) and press Action (E · Turn): it leans the other way, the beam turns on past the mirror onto the sensor, and the sensor lights up gold. Wire it to a gate with Switch opens a gate.
steps.task: Press Play and turn the mirror until the sensor lights.

steps.title: Done!
steps.body: You lit a branch at a burning torch and burned the vines with it, lit a torch stand, threw a bomb from a bomb flower at a cracked wall, and turned a mirror to bring a beam of light onto a sensor. Make your own in the Asset studio: Fire and light › Burns, Shines a beam, Flame, Grows bombs, Mirror; a switch Lit by a beam, or Hit by Fire.
